race.description: A Corp Computers Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: DYNAMIC DIVA (10) gets a lovely run in transit. She does usually get back but maybe can sit a bit closer. She does always find the line strongly. KENISIS (9) was solid in a C1 last start and will enjoy the drop to maiden company having placed in the previous two outings in this grade. Looks close to a win. MOONGLEAM (6) lands a better gate and definitely a better journey. She can improve. ROTHFIELD (3) comes off a weak race but at least was in the placings. Better ground helped there. Worth including in the exotics.
